bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,http.client,json,urllib.parse,sys
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
try:
 conn.request("POST","/oauth/start",headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body=b"{}")
 r=conn.getresponse();status=r.status;data=r.read(10000)
finally:conn.close()
if status!=200:
 print("OAUTH_START_UNAVAILABLE_HTTP="+str(status))
 sys.exit(61)
parsed=json.loads(data)
url=urllib.parse.urlsplit(parsed["authorize_url"])
scopes=urllib.parse.parse_qs(url.query).get("scope",[""])[0].split()
assert url.scheme=="https" and url.hostname=="www.tumblr.com" and url.path=="/oauth2/authorize","BAD_AUTH_TARGET"
assert set(("basic","write","offline_access")).issubset(set(scopes)),"MISSING_OAUTH_WRITE"
assert bool(urllib.parse.parse_qs(url.query).get("state")),"MISSING_STATE"
print("PRIVATE_APP_OAUTH_START=PASS")
print("EXPLICIT_WRITE_SCOPE=PASS")
print("AUTHORIZE_URL_VALIDATED_NOT_DISCLOSED=PASS")
print("REMOTE_PROVIDER_REQUESTS=ZERO")
PY
